name: Bintulu Marathon 2026
short_description: Bintulu Marathon 2026 is a full and half marathon event held on August 2, 2026 in Bintulu, Sarawak, Malaysia.
ai_summary: Bintulu Marathon 2026 is a full marathon and half marathon event scheduled for August 2, 2026, in Bintulu, Sarawak, Malaysia. The race offers two distance options: 42.195 km and 21.1 km, catering to runners seeking either a full marathon challenge or a shorter half marathon distance. Registration for this event is currently closed.
pros: Offers both full marathon (42.195 km) and half marathon (21.1 km) distance options
Takes place in Bintulu, Sarawak, a specific and identifiable Malaysian location
Clearly scheduled date of August 2, 2026 allows for advance planning
cons: Registration status is listed as Closed, meaning new sign-ups are not currently possible

research_highlights: The 2025/2026 route crosses the newly-built Tun Taib Mahmud Bridge, offering views of Sungai Kuala Kemena and the town, and organisers had a kompang group performing on the bridge for atmosphere.
Race categories are Full Marathon (42km, 7-hour cut-off), Half Marathon (21.1km, 4-hour cut-off), 10km (2h15m cut-off) and 6km Fun Run (1h30m cut-off) as run in the 2025 edition.
Race Entry Pack Collection (REPC) for the 2026 edition runs 30 July–1 August 2026 at Boulevard Shopping Mall, Bintulu.
The event has grown rapidly: from 3,535 finishers in the 2023 inaugural edition, to 5,800 in 2024, to a record 8,951 from 21 countries in 2025, with organisers targeting 10,000 for 2026.
For 2026, the full and half marathon routes have received AIMS/World Athletics international certification, and the event starts/finishes at the Old Bintulu Airport site.
research_watchouts: After the 2025 race, litter including used energy gel packets and disposable cups was left scattered along the roadside and bridge despite bins being provided at every water station.
One runner's account of the 2025 half marathon described having to cope with rain during the race ('cabaran larian dalam hujan'), suggesting wet-weather conditions are possible on race day.
The Tun Taib Mahmud Bridge section, while scenic, was described by local press as a 'challenging' part of the 2025 route.

faqs.question: When is the Bintulu Marathon 2026 taking place?
faqs.answer: The Bintulu Marathon 2026 is scheduled to take place on August 2, 2026. This date applies to the event overall, which includes both the full marathon distance of 42.195 km and the half marathon distance of 21.1 km, held in Bintulu, Sarawak, Malaysia.

faqs.question: Where is the Bintulu Marathon 2026 held?
faqs.answer: The Bintulu Marathon 2026 is held in Bintulu, which is located in the state of Sarawak, Malaysia. This location serves as the venue and host city for both the full marathon and half marathon distances offered during the event.

faqs.question: What distance options are available at the Bintulu Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The Bintulu Marathon 2026 offers two distance options for participants: a full marathon distance of 42.195 km and a half marathon distance of 21.1 km. This allows runners to choose the option that best suits their experience and training level.
